The '''SM-06 Detonator Droid''' was a model of small [[battle droid]] used by the [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. Designed to approach a target and explode, SM-06 Detonator Droids were among the forces stationed at the [[ruptured vault]] under the command of the Shroud's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Peej]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
SM-06 Detonator Droids appear as enemies in one of the [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] missions&mdash;"An Emerging Dread" for Republic players and "A Spy's Secret" for Imperials&mdash; in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
